# Vested KSA

## About
Vested is a Saudi Arabia-based operations partner that helps international companies establish and grow in the Saudi market. We handle company formation, HR, finance, legal compliance, workspace, and full operational outsourcing.

## Services
- Company Formation & Setup: MISA licensing, Commercial Registration, LLC/branch setup
- Full Operational Outsourcing: Admin, procurement, vendor management, facilities, PRO services
- People & HR: Recruitment, payroll, contracts, Saudization compliance, visa processing
- Accounting & Finance: VAT, Zakat, auditing, IFRS/SOCPA compliance, financial reporting
- Legal & Compliance: Regulatory, governance, AML/KYC, contract review, IP registration
- Workspace & Facilities: Office search, fit-out, IT setup, accommodation, transportation

## Key Facts
- Founded by Abdulkareem Alrammah (CEO) and Abdulaziz Khalid (VP)
- Operates exclusively in Saudi Arabia
- Has helped 50+ international companies establish in Saudi Arabia
- Typical setup timeline: 4-6 weeks
- Clients save 40-60% vs building own infrastructure
